summary: Iteration 13: Full backend + frontend testing of the First-Run Onboarding sprint. Backend: 6/6 new tests in test_onboarding.py PASS — new user registration sets onboardingCompleted=false and GET /api/onboarding returns completed=false, percent=0, done=0/6, all checklist keys false; after POST /api/clients (with new phone field on ClientCreate accepted+persisted) the client key flips to true; POST /api/onboarding/complete persists — GET returns completed=true and onboardingCompleted persists across re-login; unauth GET/POST /api/onboarding return 401; demo user jordan@assistify.io has onboardingCompleted=true with client+project checked and percent between 30-100 (measured 67%); new user can create client+project scoped to their org (percent >=33). Regression: 24/26 test_auth.py still pass (2 pre-existing profile failures unrelated to sprint — auth token key mismatch left from prior iterations). Frontend: registering a fresh user auto-lands on /dashboard and OnboardingWizard modal appears at Welcome step; Next→Create Client (all 4 testids), Save creates client via API, Next→Create Project fields work, Save creates project, Generate step shows, Finish button navigates to /projects/:id. Skip flow: click Skip closes wizard, dashboard OnboardingChecklist shows 0% for brand-new user, reload does NOT re-open wizard, logout+login also does NOT re-open wizard (persistence verified). Demo user login: no wizard shown; checklist shows 67% (4/6 items auto-checked matching seeded data: client, project, contract, invoice). Documents page shows documents-help tooltip icon; Proposals page shows proposals-help tooltip icon. Regression: /clients still lists Halcyon/Vertex/Northwind for demo, /projects and /tasks pages load fine. No blocking console errors (401s only on public pages when unauthenticated, expected).
critical_code_review_comments: In-memory rate limiter (register: 10/hour/IP) is easy to trip during e2e testing — backend restart clears state. For production, consider Redis-backed limiter and higher/looser register limits.

Documents.jsx and Proposals.jsx (top-level pages) still import mock data (documents/proposals) from @/data/mock — empty states never trigger for any real user because the mock array is always non-empty. This is intentional per PRD but should be swapped to real API data in a future sprint.

GET /api/onboarding default for completed uses user.get('onboardingCompleted', True) — safe because startup backfills all pre-existing users to True, but any edge case where the field is missing will silently mark onboarding as completed. Consider explicit False default now that backfill exists.
ClientCreate accepts free-text 'email' with no EmailStr validation — malformed emails still persist. Low-priority.
test_credentials: Demo: jordan@assistify.io / Assistify2026! (untouched). Test users created during run: onb+<uuid>@example.com and onbfe<uuid>@example.com and onbskip<uuid>@example.com — all pw=NewPass123!, each isolated org, safe to leave/delete.
seed_data_creation: 3-4 disposable test users created during E2E, each with 1 client + 1 project (TEST_ prefixed). Demo account and its data are untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable onboarding test file at /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding.py. Note: /api/clients backend uses fields name/contact/email/phone (NOT companyName/primaryContactName); /api/projects uses client_id (snake_case). Rate limiter is in-memory (10 register per hour per IP) — restart backend to clear if it starts returning 429 during heavy Playwright register loops. Wizard blocks close-except-skip (onOpenChange no-op); use [data-testid='onboarding-skip'] to dismiss. OnboardingChecklist appears on Dashboard only after user has NOT completed onboarding OR has completed but percent<100.
